Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.a1: Radyo ÖzÜ is the official student radio station of Özyeğin University in Istanbul, Turkey. Founded in November 2013, it now offers a 24/7 music stream and live student-run shows refreshed every week.
Faq.q2: How can I listen to Radyo ÖzÜ?
Faq.a2: Open radyoozu.com and press play — the live stream starts right in your browser, no app needed. The weekly schedule is on the Broadcasts page.
Faq.q3: Can I host a show on Radyo ÖzÜ?
Faq.a3: Yes. If you are an Özyeğin University student, apply via the email address on the Contact page or through our Instagram.
